title: Psalms 126
paragraphs: ¹ When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream. ² Then our mouths were filled with laughter and our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them." ³ The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy. ⁴ Restore our fortunes, LORD, like streams in the desert. ⁵ Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
⁶ Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.
